column1: # The two sweeps the README quotes from batches of their own, re-run on the v14 build (1 MiB
# chunk, +cssc). Both were measured before those landed, and a build change is a stronger
# objection to a stale number than batch drift is.
# v8 against v9 across thread counts: does the win still shrink as threads are added?
# Table size, whole binary at 18 threads. The claim under test is that it is flat from 2^13 up
# and worse below, so the 2^14 default is chosen for footprint rather than speed.
# Pushing the read floor lower. Every one of these lost before; the 1 MiB chunk changes the
# baseline they lost against, so they are re-priced rather than assumed.
